no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting is recommended for this application.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for CABLIVI (caplacizumab-yhdp, BLA761112). The multidisciplinary review states plainly that no Advisory Committee Meeting was recommended for this application, and the approval letter explains the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for a biologic of this class or in the intended population. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm concern-to-change linkages.
